items.title: Kimberly Clark (KMB) Completes Kenvue Acquisition
items.summary: Kimberly-Clark (NasdaqGS:KMB) has completed its acquisition of Kenvue, creating a larger consumer health and wellness business. Former Kenvue executives have joined Kimberly-Clark's board and key committees as part of the post-deal leadership reshuffle. Kimberly-Clark has adopted material amendments to its bylaws to reflect the combined structure after closing the Kenvue transaction. The Kenvue acquisition and board reshaping are only one part of the broader Kimberly-Clark investment story...
